findings.message: web/src/pages/Cases/CaseDetails/Voting/Shutter/Reveal.tsx:48-49 replaces the repo-wide `isUndefined` helper from src/utils with an inline `=== undefined || === null` check, and adds a comment that explains a test-harness limitation in production code. The behaviour is identical to `isUndefined`, so there is no functional regression. Still, it departs from the pattern the sibling Commit.tsx and useRevealVote.ts use, and it goes beyond the fix described in decisions.md. Mocking `src/utils` inside Reveal.test.tsx would have kept the production code idiomatic.
findings.requirement: Change only the owned paths in `policy.json`. Keep the existing structure, names and patterns. No new dependencies.
